<![CDATA[import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Archivo_Black, IBM_Plex_Mono, Manrope } from "next/font/google";
import "./truecut/truecut.css";

const display = Archivo_Black({
  weight: "400",
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-truecut-display",
});

const body = Manrope({
  weight: ["400", "500", "600", "700"],
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-truecut-body",
});

const mono = IBM_Plex_Mono({
  weight: ["400", "500"],
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-truecut-mono",
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  metadataBase: new URL("https://openlandingpage.vercel.app"),
  title: "TRUECUT Works — Field engineering, shown clearly",
  description: "A proof-first conversion landing page for field engineering and commissioning crews.",
  icons: { icon: "/templates/truecut/icon.svg" },
};

export default function TruecutLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={`${display.variable} ${body.variable} ${mono.variable}`}>
      <body className="tc-body">
        <noscript>
          <style>{`[data-tc-reveal]{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;clip-path:none!important}.tc-video-control{display:none}`}</style>
        </noscript>
        {children}
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(truecut)/truecut/assets.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { ASSETS } from "./assets.generated";
import { VIDEO_ASSETS } from "./videos.generated";
import { VideoPlayer } from "./VideoPlayer";

const BASE = "/templates/truecut";

export function assetSrc(key: string, width: 800 | 1600, format: "webp" | "avif" = "webp"): string | null {
  return key in ASSETS ? `${BASE}/${key}-${width}.${format}` : null;
}

type PictureProps = {
  assetKey: string;
  alt: string;
  className?: string;
  sizes?: string;
  priority?: boolean;
};

export function Picture({ assetKey, alt, className = "", sizes = "(min-width: 900px) 50vw, 100vw", priority = false }: PictureProps) {
  const webp800 = assetSrc(assetKey, 800);
  if (!webp800) {
    return (
      <div className={`tc-media-placeholder ${className}`} role="img" aria-label={`Picture: ${alt}`} data-asset={assetKey}>
        <span className="tc-media-placeholder-grid" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="tc-media-placeholder-label">Picture / {assetKey}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { w, h } = ASSETS[assetKey];
  const set = (format: "webp" | "avif") => `${assetSrc(assetKey, 800, format)} 800w, ${assetSrc(assetKey, 1600, format)} 1600w`;
  return (
    <picture className={`tc-picture ${className}`} data-asset={assetKey}>
      <source type="image/avif" srcSet={set("avif")} sizes={sizes} />
      <img
        src={webp800}
        srcSet={set("webp")}
        sizes={sizes}
        width={w}
        height={h}
        alt={alt}
        loading={priority ? "eager" : "lazy"}
        fetchPriority={priority ? "high" : undefined}
        decoding="async"
      />
    </picture>
  );
}

type VideoFrameProps = {
  videoKey: string;
  posterKey?: string;
  posterAlt: string;
  className?: string;
  label?: string;
  priority?: boolean;
};

export function VideoFrame({ videoKey, posterKey, posterAlt, className = "", label = "Field reel", priority = false }: VideoFrameProps) {
  const video = VIDEO_ASSETS[videoKey];
  const poster = posterKey ? <Picture assetKey={posterKey} alt={posterAlt} className="tc-video-poster" priority={priority} sizes={priority ? "100vw" : undefined} /> : <span className="tc-media-placeholder-grid" aria-hidden="true" />;
  if (!video) {
    return (
      <div className={`tc-video-placeholder ${className}`} role="img" aria-label={`Video placeholder: ${label}`} data-video={videoKey}>
        {poster}
        <span className="tc-video-placeholder-overlay">
          <span className="tc-play-mark" aria-hidden="true">▶</span>
          <span><b>Video</b> / {videoKey}.mp4</span>
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <VideoPlayer videoKey={videoKey} desktop={`${BASE}/clips/${video.desktop}`} mobile={`${BASE}/clips/${video.mobile}`} label={label} className={className}>
      {poster}
    </VideoPlayer>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import { ImageResponse } from "next/og";

<![CDATA[import { Logo } from "./brand/Logo";
import { ScrollFieldLog } from "./motion/ScrollFieldLog";
import { Booking } from "./sections/Booking";
import { Capabilities } from "./sections/Capabilities";
import { FieldReel } from "./sections/FieldReel";
import { Hero } from "./sections/Hero";
import { Method } from "./sections/Method";
import { Projects } from "./sections/Projects";
import { SiteHeader } from "./sections/SiteHeader";

export default function TruecutPage() {
  return (
    <ScrollFieldLog>
      <SiteHeader />
      <main id="main">
        <Hero />
        <Capabilities />
        <FieldReel />
        <Projects />
        <Method />
        <Booking />
      </main>
      <footer className="tc-footer">
        <div className="tc-container tc-footer-inner">
          <Logo compact />
          <p>TRUECUT Works is a fictional conversion template. Media placeholders are ready for your own field photography and short proof reels.</p>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </ScrollFieldLog>
  );
}

<![CDATA[@import "tailwindcss";

@theme {
  --color-tc-asphalt: #172026;
  --color-tc-paper: #F5F0E5;
  --color-tc-accent: #E8F146;
  --color-tc-steel: #B4C3C1;
  --color-tc-oxide: #4B6A72;
  --color-tc-rust: #C96B45;
  --font-tc-display: var(--font-truecut-display), Impact, sans-serif;
  --font-tc-body: var(--font-truecut-body), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif;
  --font-tc-mono: var(--font-truecut-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;
  --ease-tc-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --ease-tc-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-tc-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1);
  --ease-tc-spring: linear(0, 0.35 8%, 0.82 20%, 1.06 30%, 1.02 42%, 0.99 58%, 1);
  --duration-tc-instant: 90ms;
  --duration-tc-fast: 180ms;
  --duration-tc-base: 420ms;
  --duration-tc-slow: 800ms;
  --duration-tc-hero: 1200ms;
}

:root {
  --tc-asphalt: #172026;
  --tc-paper: #F5F0E5;
  --tc-accent: #E8F146;
  --tc-steel: #B4C3C1;
  --tc-oxide: #4B6A72;
  --tc-rust: #C96B45;
  --tc-container: 1260px;
  --tc-gutter: clamp(20px, 5vw, 76px);
  --tc-section-gap: clamp(88px, 12vw, 180px);
  --tc-radius: 2px;
  --tc-progress: 0;
  --tc-progress-pct: 0%;
  --tc-reveal-shift: 28px;
  --tc-stagger: 70ms;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; background: var(--tc-paper); }
html, body { overflow-x: clip; }
body { margin: 0; min-width: 320px; background: var(--tc-paper); color: var(--tc-asphalt); font-family: var(--font-tc-body); }
button, input { font: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; }
img, video { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
a { color: inherit; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--tc-accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

.tc-app { position: relative; overflow: clip; }
.tc-container { width: min(var(--tc-container), calc(100% - (var(--tc-gutter) * 2))); margin-inline: auto; }
.tc-main { position: relative; }
.tc-skip { position: fixed; z-index: 50; top: -70px; left: var(--tc-gutter); padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--tc-accent); color: var(--tc-asphalt); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: top var(--duration-tc-fast) var(--ease-tc-out); }
.tc-skip:focus { top: 16px; }

/* Chrome + field log rail */
.tc-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; display: flex; min-height: 72px; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-asphalt) 16%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-paper) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); transition: min-height var(--duration-tc-base) var(--ease-tc-out), background var(--duration-tc-base) var(--ease-tc-out); }
.tc-app[data-tc-scrolled="true"] .tc-header { min-height: 60px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-paper) 98%, transparent); }
.tc-header-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; }
.tc-header-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: var(--tc-oxide); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tc-header-status i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tc-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-accent) 28%, transparent); }
.tc-header-cta { white-space: nowrap; }
.tc-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--tc-asphalt); text-decoration: none; }
.tc-logo-mark { width: 32px; height: 32px; flex: none; }
.tc-logo-word { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 7px; font: 400 18px/1 var(--font-tc-display); letter-spacing: -.03em; }
.tc-logo-word span { color: var(--tc-oxide); font: 500 9px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .16em; }
.tc-logo--compact .tc-logo-mark { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
.tc-logo--compact .tc-logo-word { font-size: 14px; }
.tc-signal-line { position: fixed; inset: 0 auto auto 0; z-index: 40; width: 100%; height: 3px; transform: scaleX(var(--tc-progress)); transform-origin: left; background: var(--tc-accent); pointer-events: none; }
.tc-field-rail { position: fixed; z-index: 12; top: 118px; bottom: 50px; left: clamp(10px, 2vw, 28px); display: flex; width: 20px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; pointer-events: none; }
.tc-field-rail-track { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto; width: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-oxide) 34%, transparent); }
.tc-field-rail-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto auto; width: 2px; height: var(--tc-progress-pct); background: var(--tc-accent); transition: height 120ms linear; }
.tc-field-rail-marker { position: absolute; top: var(--tc-progress-pct); width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--tc-asphalt); background: var(--tc-accent); transform: translateY(-50%); transition: top 180ms var(--ease-tc-out); }
.tc-field-label { position: fixed; z-index: 12; right: clamp(16px, 3vw, 50px); bottom: 22px; color: var(--tc-oxide); font: 500 10px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; pointer-events: none; }
.tc-field-label strong { color: var(--tc-asphalt); }

/* Shared controls */
.tc-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--tc-accent); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tc-eyebrow::before { content: ""; width: 28px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; }
.tc-kicker { color: var(--tc-oxide); font: 500 11px/1.3 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tc-button { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; overflow: hidden; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--tc-accent); border-radius: var(--tc-radius); background: var(--tc-accent); color: var(--tc-asphalt); font: 600 12px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--duration-tc-fast) var(--ease-tc-out), transform var(--duration-tc-instant) var(--ease-tc-spring), border-color var(--duration-tc-fast) var(--ease-tc-out); }
.tc-button::before { position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: 0; content: ""; background: var(--tc-asphalt); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform var(--duration-tc-base) var(--ease-tc-out); }
.tc-button span { transition: transform var(--duration-tc-fast) var(--ease-tc-out); }
.tc-button:hover, .tc-button:focus-visible { color: var(--tc-paper); }
.tc-button:hover::before, .tc-button:focus-visible::before { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; }
.tc-button:hover span { transform: translate(3px, -3px); }
.tc-button:active { transform: scale(.97); }
.tc-button[aria-disabled="true"], .tc-button:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .6; }
.tc-button--outline { border-color: var(--tc-asphalt); background: transparent; }
.tc-button--outline::before { background: var(--tc-asphalt); }
.tc-button--outline:hover, .tc-button--outline:focus-visible { color: var(--tc-paper); }

/* Hero */
.tc-hero { position: relative; min-height: calc(100svh - 72px); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; isolation: isolate; background: var(--tc-asphalt); color: var(--tc-paper); }
.tc-hero::after { position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: 0; content: ""; background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-asphalt) 92%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-asphalt) 65%, transparent) 48%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-asphalt) 20%, transparent) 100%); pointer-events: none; }
.tc-hero-media { position: absolute; z-index: -2; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--tc-asphalt); }
.tc-hero-media.tc-video-frame { z-index: auto; overflow: visible; background: transparent; pointer-events: none; }
.tc-hero-media.tc-video-placeholder { position: absolute; }
.tc-hero-media .tc-video-visual { z-index: -2; }
.tc-hero-media .tc-video-control { right: 54px; bottom: 18px; left: auto; pointer-events: auto; }
.tc-hero-media .tc-video-placeholder, .tc-hero-media .tc-video { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.tc-hero-media .tc-media-placeholder-grid, .tc-hero-media .tc-video-placeholder { background-color: var(--tc-asphalt); }
.tc-hero-media .tc-video-placeholder-overlay { color: var(--tc-paper); }
.tc-hero-copy { width: min(1080px, calc(100% - (var(--tc-gutter) * 2))); padding: clamp(90px, 15vh, 170px) 0 clamp(52px, 9vh, 110px); }
.tc-hero-copy h1 { max-width: 18ch; margin: 22px 0 24px; font: 400 clamp(3.75rem, 7vw, 7rem)/.95 var(--font-tc-display); letter-spacing: -.04em; text-wrap: balance; }
.tc-hero .tc-button--outline { border-color: var(--tc-paper); color: var(--tc-paper); }
.tc-hero-lead { max-width: 44ch; margin: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-paper) 78%, transparent); font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.6vw, 1.35rem); line-height: 1.48; }
.tc-hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 32px; }
.tc-hero-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 18px 28px; margin-top: 50px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-paper) 28%, transparent); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-paper) 64%, transparent); font: 11px/1.3 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tc-hero-meta b { color: var(--tc-accent); font-weight: 500; }
.tc-scroll-prompt { position: absolute; right: var(--tc-gutter); bottom: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-paper) 65%, transparent); font: 10px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; writing-mode: vertical-rl; }
.tc-scroll-prompt::before { content: ""; width: 1px; height: 40px; background: var(--tc-accent); }

/* Sections + media */
.tc-section { position: relative; padding: var(--tc-section-gap) 0; scroll-margin-top: 92px; }
.tc-section--dark { background: var(--tc-asphalt); color: var(--tc-paper); }
.tc-section-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: 40px; align-items: end; margin-bottom: 54px; }
.tc-section-head h2 { max-width: 10ch; margin: 14px 0 0; font: 400 clamp(3.2rem, 6vw, 7rem)/.9 var(--font-tc-display); letter-spacing: -.065em; text-wrap: balance; }
.tc-section-head p { max-width: 45ch; margin: 0 0 5px; color: var(--tc-oxide); font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.4vw, 1.2rem); line-height: 1.55; }
.tc-section--dark .tc-section-head p { color: var(--tc-steel); }
.tc-media-frame, .tc-picture, .tc-video, .tc-video-placeholder, .tc-media-placeholder { position: relative; display: block; overflow: hidden; }
.tc-picture { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.tc-media-frame .tc-picture, .tc-project-media .tc-picture { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.tc-picture img, .tc-video { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.tc-media-placeholder, .tc-video-placeholder { min-height: 220px; background: var(--tc-steel); color: var(--tc-asphalt); }
.tc-media-placeholder-grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 24px, color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-asphalt) 15%, transparent) 25px 26px), linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 24px, color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-asphalt) 15%, transparent) 25px 26px); background-size: 26px 26px; }
.tc-media-placeholder-grid::after { position: absolute; inset: 14% 13%; content: ""; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-asphalt) 44%, transparent); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 75% 0, 100% 25%, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }
.tc-media-placeholder-label { position: absolute; right: 14px; bottom: 12px; z-index: 1; color: var(--tc-asphalt); font: 500 10px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tc-video-placeholder { background: var(--tc-asphalt); color: var(--tc-paper); }
.tc-video-placeholder .tc-video-poster { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.tc-video-placeholder-overlay { position: absolute; z-index: 2; inset: auto 16px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--tc-paper); font: 500 10px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tc-video-placeholder-overlay b { color: var(--tc-accent); font-weight: 500; }
.tc-video-frame { position: relative; min-height: 220px; }
.tc-video-frame.tc-hero-media { position: absolute; }
.tc-video-visual { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--tc-asphalt); }
.tc-video-visual > .tc-video-poster, .tc-video-visual > .tc-video { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.tc-video-visual > .tc-video { opacity: 0; }
.tc-video-visual > .tc-video[data-ready="true"] { opacity: 1; }
.tc-video-control { position: absolute; z-index: 4; left: 18px; bottom: 18px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--tc-accent); background: var(--tc-asphalt); color: var(--tc-paper); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); cursor: pointer; }
.tc-video-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tc-accent); outline-offset: 4px; }
.tc-play-mark { display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--tc-accent); color: var(--tc-accent); font-size: 10px; }

/* Capability cards */
.tc-capabilities { background: var(--tc-paper); }
.tc-cap-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; background: var(--tc-asphalt); }
.tc-cap-card { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 420px; flex-direction: column; background: var(--tc-paper); transition: transform var(--duration-tc-base) var(--ease-tc-out), background var(--duration-tc-fast) var(--ease-tc-out); }
.tc-cap-card:hover, .tc-cap-card[data-selected="true"] { z-index: 1; background: var(--tc-accent); transform: translateY(-8px); }
.tc-cap-card:focus-within { z-index: 1; }
.tc-cap-media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
.tc-cap-media .tc-media-placeholder { min-height: 0; height: 100%; }
.tc-cap-card:hover .tc-cap-media img, .tc-cap-card[data-selected="true"] .tc-cap-media img { transform: scale(1.05); }
.tc-cap-media img { transition: transform var(--duration-tc-slow) var(--ease-tc-out); }
.tc-cap-body { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; padding: 22px 20px 20px; }

.tc-cap-card h3 { margin: 22px 0 10px; font: 400 clamp(1.45rem, 2.1vw, 2rem)/.98 var(--font-tc-display); letter-spacing: -.04em; }
.tc-cap-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--tc-oxide); font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.5; }
.tc-cap-card:hover p, .tc-cap-card[data-selected="true"] p { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-asphalt) 80%, transparent); }
.tc-cap-action { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 28px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-asphalt) 18%, transparent); background: transparent; color: var(--tc-asphalt); font: 500 10px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .09em; text-align: left; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tc-cap-action span { transition: transform var(--duration-tc-fast) var(--ease-tc-out); }
.tc-cap-action:hover span, .tc-cap-action:focus-visible span { transform: translate(3px, -3px); }

/* Pinned field reel */
.tc-reel-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(300px, .85fr); gap: clamp(32px, 7vw, 104px); align-items: start; }
.tc-reel-stage { position: sticky; top: 102px; min-height: min(68vh, 680px); }

.tc-reel-stage::before { position: absolute; z-index: 2; inset: 18px 18px auto auto; width: 62px; height: 62px; content: ""; border-top: 2px solid var(--tc-accent); border-right: 2px solid var(--tc-accent); pointer-events: none; }
.tc-reel-caption { position: absolute; z-index: 3; right: 18px; bottom: 18px; padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--tc-accent); color: var(--tc-asphalt); font: 500 10px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

.tc-reel-note[data-active="true"]::before { background: var(--tc-accent); transform: scale(1.3); }

/* Project proof */
.tc-projects { background: var(--tc-asphalt); color: var(--tc-paper); }
.tc-project-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 0.88fr 0.88fr; gap: 1px; background: var(--tc-paper); }
.tc-project-card { position: relative; min-height: 580px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: var(--tc-asphalt); }

.tc-project-id { color: var(--tc-accent); font: 500 10px/1 var(--font-tc-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

.tc-method-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr); gap: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px); align-items: center; }

.tc-method-list { margin: 40px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

.tc-method-item h3 { margin: 0 0 7px; font: 400 clamp(1.45rem, 2vw, 2.2rem)/.98 var(--font-tc-display); letter-spacing: -.04em; }
.tc-method-item p { max-width: 38ch; margin: 0; color: var(--tc-steel); line-height: 1.5; }

/* Booking */
.tc-booking { background: var(--tc-paper); }
.tc-booking-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(380px, 0.95fr); gap: clamp(40px, 6vw, 90px); align-items: start; }

.tc-field input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--tc-rust); animation: tc-shake 280ms var(--ease-tc-out); }
.tc-field-error { display: block; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--tc-rust); font: 500 11px/1.3 var(--font-tc-mono); }
.tc-service-fieldset { min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }
.tc-service-fieldset legend { margin-bottom: 10px; color: var(--tc-oxide); font-size: .86rem; }
.tc-service-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 7px; }

.tc-service-option label { display: flex; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-asphalt) 23%, transparent); color: var(--tc-oxide); font: 500 11px/1.25 var(--font-tc-mono); text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--duration-tc-fast) var(--ease-tc-out), color var(--duration-tc-fast) var(--ease-tc-out), border-color var(--duration-tc-fast) var(--ease-tc-out), transform var(--duration-tc-instant) var(--ease-tc-spring); }
.tc-service-option label:hover, .tc-service-option input:focus-visible + label { border-color: var(--tc-asphalt); color: var(--tc-asphalt); }

.tc-service-option label:active { transform: scale(.98); }
.tc-form-submit { width: 100%; margin-top: 4px; }

.tc-form-success { display: grid; gap: 24px; padding-top: 24px; }
.tc-ticket { position: relative; padding: 28px 20px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--tc-asphalt); background: var(--tc-paper); }

.tc-ticket::before { left: -7px; }

/* Reveal language + hero choreography */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {

  [data-tc-reveal][data-tc-in="true"] { opacity: 1; transform: none; clip-path: inset(0); }

  [data-tc-reveal="wipe"][data-tc-in="true"] { clip-path: inset(0); }
  [data-tc-reveal="rule"] { transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; clip-path: none; }
  [data-tc-reveal="rule"][data-tc-in="true"] { transform: scaleX(1); }
  .tc-hero .tc-eyebrow { animation: tc-hero-rise var(--duration-tc-hero) var(--ease-tc-expo) both; }
  .tc-hero h1 { animation: tc-hero-rise var(--duration-tc-hero) var(--ease-tc-expo) 120ms both; }
  .tc-hero-lead { animation: tc-hero-rise var(--duration-tc-hero) var(--ease-tc-expo) 250ms both; }
  .tc-hero-actions { animation: tc-hero-rise var(--duration-tc-hero) var(--ease-tc-expo) 420ms both; }
  .tc-hero-meta { animation: tc-hero-rise var(--duration-tc-hero) var(--ease-tc-expo) 600ms both; }
  .tc-hero-media { animation: tc-hero-media var(--duration-tc-hero) var(--ease-tc-in-out) both; }
  .tc-hero .tc-scroll-prompt { animation: tc-hero-rise var(--duration-tc-hero) var(--ease-tc-expo) 900ms both; }
  .tc-hero-media .tc-video:not([poster]) { animation: tc-hero-breathe 8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .tc-cap-card:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 50ms; }
  .tc-cap-card:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 100ms; }
  .tc-cap-card:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 150ms; }
  @keyframes tc-hero-rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(28px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  @keyframes tc-hero-media { from { opacity: .35; transform: scale(1.04); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
  @keyframes tc-hero-breathe { from { transform: scale(1); } to { transform: scale(1.035); } }
  @keyframes tc-shake { 0%,100% { transform: translateX(0); } 35% { transform: translateX(-6px); } 70% { transform: translateX(5px); } }
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .tc-cap-card, .tc-project-card, .tc-reel-stage { will-change: transform; }
  .tc-project-card::after { position: absolute; z-index: 2; inset: 0; content: ""; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; background: radial-gradient(260px circle at var(--tc-mx, 50%) var(--tc-my, 50%), color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc-accent) 18%, transparent), transparent 72%); transition: opacity var(--duration-tc-fast) var(--ease-tc-out); }
  .tc-project-card:hover::after { opacity: 1; }
}

@media (max-width: 68rem) {
  .tc-header-status { display: none; }
  .tc-hero-copy h1 { font-size: clamp(4.3rem, 12vw, 8rem); }
  .tc-cap-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .tc-project-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .tc-project-card--wide { grid-row: auto; min-height: 560px; }
  .tc-project-card { min-height: 430px; }
  .tc-project-card:last-child { grid-column: span 2; }
}

@media (max-width: 54rem) {
  :root { --tc-gutter: 22px; --tc-section-gap: 100px; }
  .tc-field-rail { display: none; }
  .tc-field-label { right: 20px; bottom: 16px; }
  .tc-hero { min-height: calc(100svh - 64px); }
  .tc-hero-copy { padding: 110px 0 62px; }
  .tc-scroll-prompt { display: none; }
  .tc-section-head, .tc-reel-grid, .tc-method-grid, .tc-booking-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .tc-section-head { gap: 24px; }
  .tc-section-head h2 { max-width: 12ch; }
  .tc-reel-stage { position: relative; top: auto; min-height: 0; }
  .tc-reel-stage > .tc-video-placeholder, .tc-reel-stage > .tc-video-frame { height: min(72vw, 520px); min-height: 320px; }
  .tc-reel-notes { margin-top: 32px; }

}

@media (max-width: 39rem) {

  .tc-hero-copy { padding-top: 92px; }

  .tc-hero-lead { font-size: 1rem; }
  .tc-hero-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .tc-button { width: 100%; }
  .tc-hero-meta { gap: 12px 18px; margin-top: 38px; font-size: 9px; }
  .tc-cap-grid, .tc-project-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .tc-cap-card { min-height: 390px; }
  .tc-project-card, .tc-project-card--wide, .tc-project-card:last-child { grid-column: auto; min-height: 420px; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }

  .tc-field-rail-fill, .tc-field-rail-marker { transition: none; }
  [data-tc-reveal], .tc-hero .tc-eyebrow, .tc-hero h1, .tc-hero-lead, .tc-hero-actions, .tc-hero-meta, .tc-hero-media, .tc-hero .tc-scroll-prompt { opacity: 1; transform: none; clip-path: none; animation: none; transition: none; }
  .tc-cap-card, .tc-cap-media img, .tc-project-media img, .tc-button, .tc-button::before, .tc-button span, .tc-field input, .tc-service-option label { transition: none; }
}

    <file path="src/app/(truecut)/truecut/VideoPlayer.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";

type VideoPlayerProps = {
  videoKey: string;
  desktop: string;
  mobile: string;
  label: string;
  className: string;
  children: ReactNode;
};

export function VideoPlayer({ videoKey, desktop, mobile, label, className, children }: VideoPlayerProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const manual = useRef(false);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const video = ref.current;
    if (!video) return;
    const phone = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 699px)");
    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const connection = (navigator as Navigator & { connection?: { saveData?: boolean } }).connection;
    let visible = false;
    const sync = () => {
      const source = phone.matches ? mobile : desktop;
      if (video.getAttribute("src") !== source) {
        video.src = source;
        setReady(false);
      }
      if (!visible || reduced.matches || phone.matches || connection?.saveData) {
        video.pause();
        if (reduced.matches) setReady(false);
      } else if (!manual.current) {
        void video.play().catch(() => { /* Autoplay can be blocked; the play button remains available. */ });
      }
    };
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => { visible = entry.isIntersecting; sync(); }, { threshold: 0.1 });
    observer.observe(video);
    phone.addEventListener("change", sync);
    reduced.addEventListener("change", sync);
    sync();
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      phone.removeEventListener("change", sync);
      reduced.removeEventListener("change", sync);
      video.pause();
    };
  }, [desktop, mobile]);

  const toggle = () => {
    const video = ref.current;
    if (!video) return;
    manual.current = true;
    if (video.paused) void video.play().catch(() => setPlaying(false));
    else video.pause();
  };

  return (
    <div className={`tc-video-frame ${className}`} data-video={videoKey}>
      <div className="tc-video-visual">
        {children}
        <video
          ref={ref}
          className="tc-video"
          data-ready={ready && !failed}
          muted loop playsInline preload="none"
          width={1600} height={900}
          aria-label={label}
          onLoadedData={() => setReady(true)}
          onPlay={() => { setPlaying(true); setReady(true); }}
          onPause={() => setPlaying(false)}
          onError={() => { setFailed(true); setPlaying(false); }}
        />
      </div>
      {!failed && <button className="tc-video-control" type="button" onClick={toggle} aria-label={`${playing ? "Pause" : "Play"} ${label}`}>
        {playing ? "Pause reel" : "Play reel"}
      </button>}
    </div>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(truecut)/truecut/brand/Logo.tsx">
<![CDATA[type LogoProps = { compact?: boolean };

export function Logo({ compact = false }: LogoProps) {
  return (
    <span className={`tc-logo${compact ? " tc-logo--compact" : ""}`}>
      <svg className="tc-logo-mark" viewBox="0 0 120 120" role="img" aria-label="TRUECUT mark" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <rect x="4" y="4" width="112" height="112" fill="currentColor" />
        <path d="M24 30h44M24 46h29M24 62h44M24 78h29M24 94h44" stroke="var(--tc-accent)" strokeWidth="6" strokeLinecap="square" />
        <path d="M82 26v68M72 26h20M72 94h20" stroke="var(--tc-paper)" strokeWidth="4" fill="none" />

    <file path="src/app/(truecut)/truecut/forms/appointment.ts">
<![CDATA[export type AppointmentValues = { name: string; email: string; service: string };
export type AppointmentErrors = Partial<Record<keyof AppointmentValues, string>>;

export function validateAppointment(values: AppointmentValues): AppointmentErrors {
  const errors: AppointmentErrors = {};
  if (!values.name.trim()) errors.name = "Add your name.";
  if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(values.email.trim())) errors.email = "Enter a work email.";
  if (!values.service) errors.service = "Choose the work you need help with.";
  return errors;
}

export function ticketCode(service: string): string {
  const clean = service.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, "").toUpperCase().slice(0, 4).padEnd(4, "X");
  return `TC-${clean}`;
}

<![CDATA["use client";

import { FormEvent, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ticketCode, type AppointmentValues, validateAppointment } from "./appointment";

const services = [
  ["testing", "Testing & commissioning"],
  ["controls", "Controls & automation"],
  ["retrofit", "Retrofit & revamp"],
  ["design", "Design & engineering"],
] as const;

type FormStatus = "idle" | "loading" | "success";

export function AppointmentForm() {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<AppointmentValues>({ name: "", email: "", service: "" });
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Partial<Record<keyof AppointmentValues, string>>>({});
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<FormStatus>("idle");
  const timerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleService = (event: Event) => {
      const service = (event as CustomEvent<string>).detail;
      setValues((current) => ({ ...current, service }));
      setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, service: undefined }));
    };
    window.addEventListener("tc:service", handleService);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("tc:service", handleService);
      if (timerRef.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const update = (field: keyof AppointmentValues, value: string) => {
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
    if (errors[field]) setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: undefined }));
  };

  const submit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (status === "loading") return;
    const nextErrors = validateAppointment(values);
    if (Object.keys(nextErrors).length > 0) {
      setErrors(nextErrors);
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    setStatus("loading");
    timerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => setStatus("success"), 650);
  };

  if (status === "success") {
    return (
      <div className="tc-form-success" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        <span className="tc-stamp">Site visit requested</span>
        <div className="tc-ticket">
          <h3>On the board.</h3>
          <p>Thanks, {values.name.trim()}. The TRUECUT team has the signal and will follow up with a clear next step.</p>
          <div className="tc-ticket-meta"><span>{ticketCode(values.service)}</span><span>Local / no network</span></div>
        </div>
        <p className="tc-form-footnote">This template keeps the success state local. Connect your booking endpoint when you are ready to receive the brief.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form className="tc-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate aria-busy={status === "loading"}>
      <div className="tc-field">
        <input id="tc-name" name="name" type="text" placeholder=" " autoComplete="name" value={values.name} onChange={(event) => update("name", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.name)} aria-describedby={errors.name ? "tc-name-error" : undefined} />
        <label htmlFor="tc-name">Your name</label>
        {errors.name ? <span id="tc-name-error" className="tc-field-error">{errors.name}</span> : null}
      </div>
      <div className="tc-field">
        <input id="tc-email" name="email" type="email" placeholder=" " autoComplete="email" value={values.email} onChange={(event) => update("email", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)} aria-describedby={errors.email ? "tc-email-error" : undefined} />
        <label htmlFor="tc-email">Work email</label>
        {errors.email ? <span id="tc-email-error" className="tc-field-error">{errors.email}</span> : null}
      </div>
      <fieldset className="tc-service-fieldset" aria-describedby={errors.service ? "tc-service-error" : undefined}>
        <legend>What should we look at first?</legend>
        <div className="tc-service-options">
          {services.map(([id, label]) => (
            <div className="tc-service-option" key={id}>
              <input id={`tc-service-${id}`} name="service" type="radio" value={id} checked={values.service === id} onChange={() => update("service", id)} />
              <label htmlFor={`tc-service-${id}`}>{label}</label>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {errors.service ? <span id="tc-service-error" className="tc-field-error">{errors.service}</span> : null}
      </fieldset>
      <button className="tc-button tc-form-submit" type="submit" disabled={status === "loading"}>{status === "loading" ? "Stamping ticket…" : "Stamp my site visit"}<span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>
      <p className="tc-form-footnote">Three fields. One clear next step. Nothing is sent from this demo.</p>
    </form>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import { clamp } from "../motion/math";

export type FieldSection = { id: string; top: number; height: number };

/** Progress is measured against real section offsets, so layout changes do not break the field log. */
export function fieldProgress(scrollY: number, sections: FieldSection[], viewportHeight = 0): number {
  if (sections.length === 0) return 0;
  const line = scrollY + viewportHeight * 0.32;
  const first = sections[0];
  const last = sections[sections.length - 1];
  if (line <= first.top) return 0;
  const lastEnd = last.top + Math.max(1, last.height);
  if (line >= lastEnd) return 1;

  const index = sections.findIndex((section) => line < section.top + Math.max(1, section.height));
  const activeIndex = Math.max(0, index);
  const section = sections[activeIndex];
  const local = clamp((line - section.top) / Math.max(1, section.height));
  return clamp((activeIndex + local) / Math.max(1, sections.length - 1));
}

export function chapterFromProgress(progressValue: number, sections: FieldSection[]): string | null {
  if (sections.length === 0) return null;
  const index = Math.min(sections.length - 1, Math.floor(clamp(progressValue) * sections.length));
  return sections[index].id;
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(truecut)/truecut/motion/math.ts">
<![CDATA[export function clamp(value: number, min = 0, max = 1): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
}

export function lerp(from: number, to: number, amount: number): number {
  return from + (to - from) * amount;
}

export function progress(value: number, start: number, end: number): number {
  if (end === start) return value >= end ? 1 : 0;
  return clamp((value - start) / (end - start));
}

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

type RevealProps = {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  kind?: "rise" | "wipe" | "rule" | "stagger";
  delay?: number;
};

export function Reveal({ children, className = "", kind = "rise", delay = 0 }: RevealProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node) return;
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
      setInView(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: "-8% 0px -10%", threshold: 0 },
    );
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={className} data-tc-reveal={kind} data-tc-in={inView ? "true" : "false"} style={{ "--tc-delay": `${delay}ms` } as React.CSSProperties}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { chapterFromProgress, fieldProgress, type FieldSection } from "../mechanic/fieldLog";

type ScrollFieldLogProps = { children: React.ReactNode };

const labels: Record<string, string> = {
  site: "SITE / 01",
  proof: "PROOF / 02",
  reel: "REEL / 03",
  projects: "PROJECTS / 04",
  method: "HANDOFF / 05",
  book: "BOOK / 06",
};

export function ScrollFieldLog({ children }: ScrollFieldLogProps) {
  const appRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const frameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const [chapter, setChapter] = useState("site");

  useEffect(() => {
    const app = appRef.current;
    if (!app) return;
    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    let lastChapter = "";

    const measure = (): FieldSection[] =>
      Array.from(app.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-field-section]"))
        .map((section) => ({
          id: section.dataset.fieldSection ?? "site",
          top: section.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY,
          height: section.offsetHeight,
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => a.top - b.top);

    const update = () => {
      frameRef.current = null;
      const sections = measure();
      const value = fieldProgress(window.scrollY, sections, window.innerHeight);
      app.style.setProperty("--tc-progress", String(value));
      app.style.setProperty("--tc-progress-pct", `${value * 100}%`);
      app.dataset.tcScrolled = value > 0.025 ? "true" : "false";
      const nextChapter = chapterFromProgress(value, sections) ?? "site";
      app.dataset.tcChapter = nextChapter;
      if (nextChapter !== lastChapter) {
        lastChapter = nextChapter;
        setChapter(nextChapter);
      }
    };

    const schedule = () => {
      if (frameRef.current === null) frameRef.current = window.requestAnimationFrame(update);
    };

    schedule();
    if (!reduced) {
      window.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener("resize", schedule);
      const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(schedule);
      resizeObserver.observe(app);
      return () => {
        window.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
        window.removeEventListener("resize", schedule);
        resizeObserver.disconnect();
        if (frameRef.current !== null) window.cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
      };
    }

    return () => {
      if (frameRef.current !== null) window.cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={appRef} className="tc-app" data-tc-chapter="site">
      <div className="tc-signal-line" aria-hidden="true" />
      <aside className="tc-field-rail" aria-hidden="true">
        <span className="tc-field-rail-track" />
        <span className="tc-field-rail-fill" />
        <span className="tc-field-rail-marker" />
      </aside>
      <p className="tc-field-label" aria-live="polite"><strong>{labels[chapter] ?? chapter}</strong> / SIGNAL: CLEAR</p>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { VideoFrame } from "../assets";
import { FieldLogNote } from "../mechanic/FieldLogNote";
import { Reveal } from "../motion/Reveals";

const notes = [
  { index: "01 / SITE", title: "Start with the signal.", body: "We arrive with the drawings, the instruments, and the question that needs a real answer.", tag: "Scope / ready" },
  { index: "02 / PROOF", title: "Show the reading.", body: "Testing and commissioning become visible: what changed, what held, and what is ready for sign-off.", tag: "Test / verified" },
  { index: "03 / HANDOFF", title: "Leave it legible.", body: "The closeout is part of the work: clean panels, clear notes, and a person who owns the next step.", tag: "Handoff / clear" },
];

export function FieldReel() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".tc-reel-note"));
    if (!items.length) return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          const index = items.indexOf(entry.target as HTMLElement);
          if (index >= 0) setActive(index);
        }
      }),
      { threshold: 0.55 },
    );
    items.forEach((item) => observer.observe(item));
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return (
    <section id="reel" className="tc-section tc-section--dark tc-field-section" data-field-section="reel" aria-labelledby="reel-title">
      <div className="tc-container">
        <Reveal className="tc-section-head" kind="rule">
          <div>
            <span className="tc-eyebrow">Field reel / handoff</span>
            <h2 id="reel-title">A site walk you can feel.</h2>
          </div>
          <p>One pinned stage keeps the proof in view while the field log moves from arrival to reading to sign-off.</p>
        </Reveal>
        <div className="tc-reel-grid">
          <div className="tc-reel-stage">
            <VideoFrame videoKey="process-proof" posterKey="project-panel-detail" posterAlt="Relay panel before and after commissioning" label="Process proof reel" />
            <span className="tc-reel-caption">{notes[active].index} / SIGNAL: CLEAR</span>
          </div>
          <ol className="tc-reel-notes">
            {notes.map((note, index) => <FieldLogNote key={note.index} {...note} active={active === index} />)}
          </ol>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

<![CDATA["use client";

import type { PointerEvent } from "react";
import { Picture } from "../assets";
import { Reveal } from "../motion/Reveals";

const projects = [
  { id: "PROJECT 0427", title: "A clean read at the switchyard.", body: "Testing and commissioning with a handoff that stayed on schedule.", asset: "project-switchyard", wide: true },
  { id: "PROJECT 0318", title: "Controls that stay legible.", body: "A calm control-room retrofit with the right signals in the right places.", asset: "project-control-room", wide: false },
  { id: "PROJECT 0196", title: "The detail is the proof.", body: "Panel finish, cable discipline, and a closeout the next crew can trust.", asset: "project-panel-detail", wide: false },
];

export function Projects() {
  const move = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    const card = event.currentTarget;
    const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
    card.style.setProperty("--tc-mx", `${((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100}%`);
    card.style.setProperty("--tc-my", `${((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100}%`);
  };

  return (
    <section id="projects" className="tc-section tc-projects tc-field-section" data-field-section="projects" aria-labelledby="projects-title">
      <div className="tc-container">
        <Reveal className="tc-section-head" kind="rule">

            <span className="tc-eyebrow">Project proof / selected frames</span>
            <h2 id="projects-title">Show the handoff.</h2>
          </div>
          <p>Project cards carry the evidence that helps the right visitor recognize the work, the environment, and the standard.</p>
        </Reveal>
        <div className="tc-project-grid">
          {projects.map((project, index) => (
            <Reveal key={project.id} className={`tc-project-card${project.wide ? " tc-project-card--wide" : ""}`} kind="wipe" delay={index * 90}>
              <article onPointerMove={move}>
                <div className="tc-project-media"><Picture assetKey={project.asset} alt={project.title} sizes={project.wide ? "(min-width: 900px) 50vw, 100vw" : "(min-width: 900px) 25vw, 100vw"} /></div>
                <div className="tc-project-content">
                  <span className="tc-project-id">{project.id}</span>
                  <h3>{project.title}</h3>
                  <p>{project.body}</p>
                  <span className="tc-project-arrow">Read the field note ↗</span>
                </div>
              </article>
            </Reveal>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
